bio.text: Illapa Sairitupac is the Democratic candidate for New York State Assembly District 65 in the November 3, 2026 general election; Ballotpedia reports he advanced from the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey, he described himself as the son of Peruvian immigrants, a tenant organizer and an organizer with the This Land is Ours Community Land Trust.
In the same survey he said he holds a Master of Social Work from NYU, previously worked as a mental healthcare worker, and has lived on the Lower East Side for almost 14 years.
